Messages.Author: Lazvernius
Messages.Body:
Hello All,

first question for me. If i have two kyasid in my crypt, i can put both in my uncontrolled region and split three counters (2 on one vampire and 1 on another) ?

Search your crypt for any Kiasyd (shuffle afterward), reveal them, and move them to your uncontrolled region, then distribute 3 blood from the blood bank among one or more Kiasyd in your uncontrolled region.

i don't know if any mean one or more and them mean many or the gender of the Kiasyd.

thank you for your help

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The card text migration made it ambiguous indeed.
The card searches the crypt for one Kiasyd, and distributes 3 blood among one or more Kiasyd (Kiasyds?)

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

thank you for your answer. An older post say that Kyasid stay Kyasid in plurial form

the text change in 2019 (from a to any). Any is use for plurial form too

I m wrong ?
